title: fix(plugin-auth, driver-sql)!: fail closed on a missing auth secret outside development; compile window functions from closed tables
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoFczGz9PyHzzvPyUf2P99fn)_

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Two small hardenings, one commit each, each with its own changeset. Draft: it waits for the maintainer's review.

## 1 · plugin-auth: the temporary auth secret is admitted on a development boot only

`generateSecret` (`auth-manager-database-secret.ts`) fell back to a temporary `dev-secret-` value whenever `NODE_ENV` was anything but exactly `production`. It now admits that fallback only when `isDevelopmentBoot` from `@objectstack/core` holds (`NODE_ENV=development`) or under `NODE_ENV=test`, the same pair core's own production fuse reads (`isCloudManaged`). Every other boot without `OS_AUTH_SECRET` (or its legacy spellings, or a `secret` option) refuses to start, as `production` already did.

- **CLI boots are unchanged.** `os serve` sets `NODE_ENV=production` when it is unset and `development` under `--dev`; `os start` does the same for the child it spawns. So only an embedder that constructs `AuthPlugin` / `AuthManager` itself with no secret and no `NODE_ENV=development` sees the new refusal.
- **Why `test` is kept.** Vitest sets `NODE_ENV=test`, and the full plugin-auth suite constructs managers without a secret. Core's own fuse treats `test` as non-production for the same reason.
- **Tests:** the existing guard block in `auth-manager.test.ts` gains an unset `NODE_ENV` case, four custom values (`staging`, `Production`, `dev`, empty), and a `test` case.

## 2 · driver-sql: `findWithWindowFunctions()` compiles from closed tables and quoted columns

`buildWindowFunction` assembled `FUNC() OVER (PARTITION BY … ORDER BY …)` as text. Now:

- the function name is looked up in a closed table, `row_number`, `rank`, `dense_rank`, `percent_rank`, `cume_dist` (any case). These are the argument-less functions the door's flat shape can express. Anything else answers `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 before a statement is sent.
- the sort direction is `asc` or `desc` (any case, default `asc`); anything else answers `INVALID_QUERY` / 400.
- every `partitionBy` / `orderBy` field is emitted with `knex.ref(...).toQuery()`, the quoting idiom this file already uses for columns.

**Why parameterised, not removed.** The dispatch preferred deleting the method. Measured first: nothing in objectstack, objectui or hotcrm calls it outside driver-sql's own tests and the turso override. It is still a published door, though. The protocol-17 migration `query-window-functions-retired` and the `query.windowFunctions` tombstone in `packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts` both prescribe `SqlDriver.findWithWindowFunctions()` as the replacement for the retired request key, and the 17.0 release notes and `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` document it. Removing it would retire a capability those texts tell embedders to migrate to. This PR keeps it and closes the string assembly instead. If the maintainer prefers removal, that is a follow-up that also rewrites those prescriptions.

- **Tests:** a new `sql-driver-window-function-compilation.test.ts` covers the five functions in mixed case, three refused names, both directions plus the default, a refused direction, the exact compiled text, and a field-slot expression read as a column name.

## Red on `main`, green here

Each fix was committed first, then the source file alone was restored from `main` (`19d3720`) and the new tests were run:

- plugin-auth guard block: **6 failed / 3 passed** on `main`'s source; **9 passed** with the fix.
- window-function compilation: **6 failed / 6 passed** on `main`'s source (the six passes are the accepted spellings); **12 passed** with the fix.

## Local verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: **191 files, 3613 passed, 10 skipped**
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: **235 files passed, 12 skipped; 3787 passed, 212 skipped**
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) run locally: all **74** derived families exit 0 at `329dd94a` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). Four needed a real-declaration build or a deeper fetch first and were re-run after it.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth --filter @objectstack/driver-sql run typecheck` after a real-declaration build of both closures: exit 0
- Dogfood battery (owed by the narrowing changesets): run on this head after the PR opens; the result goes to the reviewer thread.

## Acceptance notes

- `driver-sqlite-wasm` and `driver-turso` (local and replica transports) inherit the builder, so they get the same closed compilation. The turso remote transport already refused this door.
- No issue is linked: this work was dispatched directly.
